columns.edge_share: share of NFL snaps at EDGE/OLB (0-1)
columns.ngs_athleticism_score: NGS athleticism score, missing filled with the DL median
columns.ten_yd_split_z: official 10-yd split, z within class, blank if not run (filled inside each fold)
columns.three_cone_z: official 3-cone, z within class, blank if not run (filled inside each fold)
columns.burst_z: rush-drill burst, z within class (blank if no clean rep)
columns.press_eb: pressure rate %, shrunk toward 8.09% with 117.2 prior rushes
columns.fc: leave-one-class-out baseline forecast of press_eb (%), fit on all rows of the other two classes; blank for linemen without a hoop lap
columns.in_an: in the model set (both drills, 30+ rushes)
